rationale: Four major findings across correctness, stability, test coverage, and commit standards. All are mechanical fixes with no architectural impact. Blind, edge-case, and acceptance lenses all ran successfully. Deferred: concurrent double-click race (EC-001/EC-007), indexModels in-flight deduplication (EC-003), modal-dismiss-before-settle UX (EC-006), and the Array.isArray guard on response data (pre-existing codebase pattern, not introduced here). Dismissed: useSnapshot cast, menuItems without useMemo, enterprise-tab async-config race (all pre-existing patterns).

standards_review.notes: All 6 branch commits use lowercase first word after colon ('add ...', 'wire ...'). Pattern requires [A-Z][a-z]* first word. Enforced by Tekton CI. Fix by amending/rebasing before MR, or ensure squash commit subject is correctly capitalised.
No dangerouslySetInnerHTML, no HTML sinks, no open-redirect, no secrets. model.label interpolated into JSX text nodes and ConfirmationModal header prop (both safe text rendering).

findings.problem: baseName is interpolated into the PUT URL path without encodeURIComponent. A model whose base_name contains a forward slash (e.g. 'org/model', a valid format in some LiteLLM registries) silently creates extra path segments and hits a wrong or nonexistent endpoint.
findings.impact: Status updates for slash-containing model names silently 404 or hit an unintended resource with no indication to the user beyond the generic error toast.

findings.problem: STATUS_CONFIG[status] returns undefined when the server returns an unrecognised status value (future enum extension, typo, or null). Destructuring { label, dotClass } from undefined throws, crashing the row render for every affected model.
findings.impact: One model row with a bad or future status value crashes the entire table render with no error boundary. Page shows a white crash instead of degrading gracefully.
findings.recommendation: Add a fallback: const config = STATUS_CONFIG[status as ModelPlatformStatus] ?? { label: String(status) || 'Unknown', dotClass: 'bg-surface-base-quaternary' }. This keeps the table rendering and surfaces the raw value.

findings.problem: Three test requirements from spec §9 are missing from the page test suite: (a) API error on status change shows error toast — toaster.error is mocked but never asserted; (b) Enable action (no confirmation) wiring through the page's handleStatusChange — tested only in ModelActions isolation; (c) ModelsManagementPage rendered at /settings/administration/models in a router context — all page tests mount the component bare.
findings.impact: The integration between ModelActions' onStatusChange prop and the page's store dispatch is unverified. Route registration typos and error-toast regressions would not be caught.
findings.recommendation: (a) Add a test that rejects setModelStatus and asserts toaster.error is called. (b) Add a test that renders a disabled model row, clicks Enable, and asserts setModelStatus was called with the base_name and 'enabled'. (c) Add a test that wraps the page in a MemoryRouter at the /settings/administration/models path and asserts 'Model management' is visible.

findings.problem: All 6 commit subjects use a lowercase first word after the ticket prefix ('add ...', 'wire ...'). The git-workflow.md blocking standard requires the first word to start with uppercase (e.g. 'Add', 'Wire') and this format is enforced by Tekton CI.
findings.impact: CI will block the MR unless corrected. Per the squash-merge strategy this can be fixed by ensuring the squash commit subject is correctly capitalised at MR creation time.
findings.recommendation: At MR creation, set the squash commit subject to follow the format: 'EPMCDME-15078: Add model management admin UI'. Alternatively, rebase and rename individual commits if branch commit history is to be preserved.
